description: Run a trained AutoML model against a list of input rows. Returns calibrated probabilities in [0, 1] for classification (positive-class probability) or numeric predictions for regression. v1.6.5 path: calibrated, polarity-correct.

inputs.description: Array of feature dicts, e.g. [{col1: v1, col2: v2}, ...]. All rows must have the same columns.

return_proba.description: Return probabilities (true, default) vs raw predictions (currently ignored - AIDB v1.6.5 always returns calibrated proba for classification).

name: predict
